newsitem.title: GERMANY: Platinum squeeze could curb Degussa output.
newsitem.headline: Platinum squeeze could curb Degussa output.

text.p: German catalytic converter maker Degussa AG could face production curbs if the current supply squeeze on the platinum market continues for another three to four weeks, a company official said.
"That is the warning flag we are raising," Ralf Drieselmann, head of precious metals trading, told Reuters.
Degussa produces 15 to 25 percent of the world's catalytic converters, which filter harmful gases and particles from auto exhausts. It also makes other products that use platinum.
Russian dealers now negotiating in Japan have said that platinum exports could resume on June 20, but that remains to be seen, Drieselmann said.
Platinum prices have soared to $500 an ounce from $400 on Monday due to tight physical supply.
